name: SOC-002: Windows Credential Access Attempt
description: Detects attempts to access Windows credential stores including LSASS memory dumping, SAM registry hive extraction, and Mimikatz usage.
aql_expression: SELECT QIDNAME(qid) as EventName, sourceIP, destinationIP, username, LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) as LogSource, payload, starttime FROM events WHERE LOGSOURCENAME(logsourceid) ILIKE '%Windows%' AND (payload ILIKE '%lsass.exe%' OR payload ILIKE '%mimikatz%' OR payload ILIKE '%sekurlsa%' OR payload ILIKE '%reg save%sam%' OR payload ILIKE '%reg save%system%' OR payload ILIKE '%ntdsutil%') ORDER BY starttime DESC LAST 300 SECONDS
